missing_fields.caller_model: The MCP service records have no client, provider, or model identifier; the agent-usage receipt does not provide an event-level join from the 119 service refusals to a model.
missing_fields.recovery_result_semantics: The privacy-safe receipts omit request values and tool-result content, so the 119 first recovery results cannot be assigned to the preregistered semantic categories.
missing_fields.verbatim_consumability: The retained aggregate proves the owner vector was complete, but it omits the required selector, unique-answer relation, and refusal answer token needed by the registered test.

retained_aggregate_evidence.interpretation_limit: These subrequest counts combine current and legacy refusal strata and cannot be reassigned to the current 119 without event-level rows.
